coordinate_system: Output pixels. Rect=[x,y,w,h]; bbox sheet-global [left,top,right_exclusive,bottom_exclusive]; pivot, head anchor and eye center cell-local.

head_source.method: User-approved refined face. Exact pixel mask translated; integer shear rotation for death only.

normalization.alpha: Threshold 200 to binary 0/255; no soft glow.
normalization.idle: Six translated copies of face-refined native.
normalization.run: Head x fixed relative to pivot; y midpoint ±1 logical pixel.
normalization.dash: Backward frames 5–8 exactly reuse forward frames 5–8.
normalization.ult: Torso and legs fixed relative to pivot.
normalization.q: Both pistols at shoulder height. Frame 4 muzzle flash; separate beam not included.
